You can encrypt messages with my [PGP public key](./key.gpg). Encryption guide:

```shell
$ curl --tlsv1.3 --max-redirs 0 https://github.com/Proximyst.gpg | gpg --import -
$ echo 'get your message here' | gpg --encrypt --armor --recipient 'Mariell Hoversholm' --output message.asc
# The message is now in message.asc.
```

Alternatively, use one of my age keys. Encryption guide:

```shell
$ echo 'get your message here' | age --encrypt -o msg.txt.age -r 
# The message is now in msg.txt.age

# or with non-post-quantum recipient key if you don't have an up-to-date age version:
$ echo 'get your message here' | age --encrypt -o msg.txt.age -r age1mg3c3hen2duwgujl57w6ffmctl0tr0vzcy5ln7m8rjseyheulqdqryg3c4
# The message is now in msg.txt.age
```
